user.title: Solar Accelerator Home - API Key
user.description:
Enter the API key generated in the SolarAccelerator panel.

This integration does NOT control the inverter — it only receives prices/profit from SolarAccelerator and registers accessories (EV chargers, controllable loads).

error.invalid_api_key_format: API key must start with 'sa_haapi_' and be at least 40 characters
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the server
error.integration_disabled: Integration is disabled. Enable it in SolarAccelerator settings.
